name: Build To Heaven!
desc:
🚀 Build Up to Heaven and Discover What Awaits Above! ☁️

Welcome to Build Up to Heaven! Get ready to:

🧱 Stack and build your way through layers of sky-high platforms!
🔨 Upgrade your tools to build faster and reach incredible heights!
📜 Complete quests to unlock heavenly rewards and surprises!
🐣 Hatch mystical eggs to gain pets that boost your building power!
🌤️ Explore sky worlds, each with magical materials and hidden wonders!

How high can you build? Can you reach the gates of Heaven? ✨

If you're having fun, don’t forget to hit that 👍 and share the journey with your friends! 😄
